candidate_selection: Exactly the predeclared eleven train/dev readout candidates; verify selected cached logits against real merged GPU inference before fitting. No calibrated/final outputs select weights.
calibration: Reuse the explicitly inspected B/C/D cohorts, split temperature/policy groups by the existing group hash. One common threshold per type from ascending 0.005 grid; every fitting cohort <=12% expected error and >=60% coverage. No fitting on either new validation population or final.
original_final_status: Previously inspected, diagnostic/regression only. Not an independent result for any recovery candidate.
fresh_final_inference: Only after all development and policy-validation prerequisites; freeze exact model, policy, sources and data first. One independent final attempt; failure requires another prospective design.
runtime: Same RTX4060Ti one-photo/one-question/six-candidates/40-photo resident HTTP protocol, p95 <=300ms and one forward/zero answer tokens.
packaging: All mandatory gates and exact bundled-wheel real inference must pass; HF actual publication separately configured.
